dimensions.name: Legal and regulatory
dimensions.evidence: Mandate and authority; enabling ordinances/resolutions; legal opinion; approvals pathway; land tenure and rights; regulatory permits.
levels: No documented mandate or legal pathway; material authority gaps.
Initial legal review or draft instrument exists; pathway incomplete.
Mandate and approvals pathway documented; required legal checks evidenced.
Legal framework routinely applied, monitored and updated.
dimensions.response: Issue BARMM PPP policy/guidance; map approval routes and responsibilities; develop legal checklists.
dimensions.outputs: Approved policy/guidance; legal pathway map; checklist; legal reviews.

dimensions.name: Governance and institutional
dimensions.evidence: PPP focal person/team; staffing and competencies; delegations; committee terms of reference; inter-agency coordination and decision records.
levels: No assigned focal person/team or defined responsibilities.
Focal person or ad hoc team exists; roles and processes incomplete.
Designated team, approved roles and functioning coordination arrangements.
Resourced institutional unit/team with routine performance review.
dimensions.response: Establish inter-agency coordination; designate focal persons; define roles and decision rights.
dimensions.outputs: Coordination mechanism; focal-person roster; terms of reference; workplan.

dimensions.name: Project preparation and technical
dimensions.evidence: Project concept; options analysis; pre-feasibility and feasibility; demand forecasts; engineering; environmental, social and climate safeguards.
levels: No documented project concept or preparation process.
Concept notes or preliminary studies exist but key analyses are missing.
Adequate studies and documented quality review support project decisions.
Repeatable project preparation system with quality assurance and updating.
dimensions.response: Adopt screening/preparation gates; develop concept and pre-feasibility templates; build technical capability.
dimensions.outputs: Project inventory; screened pipeline; pre-feasibility reports; safeguards records.

dimensions.name: Financial and fiscal
dimensions.evidence: Affordability; budget forecasts; revenue assumptions; fiscal commitments; contingent liabilities; value-for-money and risk allocation.
levels: No affordability or fiscal-risk analysis.
Preliminary cost/revenue estimates; incomplete affordability or risk work.
Documented affordability and fiscal-risk assessment with budget coordination.
Regular fiscal-risk monitoring, disclosure and integration into medium-term planning.
dimensions.response: Adopt affordability and fiscal-risk protocols; strengthen budget coordination; require transparent value-for-money analysis.
dimensions.outputs: Affordability assessments; fiscal-risk register; budget endorsement; VfM/risk analysis.

dimensions.name: Procurement and contract management
dimensions.evidence: Procurement strategy; competitive process; bid evaluation capability; contract documentation; performance indicators and contract management plan.
levels: No PPP procurement or contract-management arrangements.
Initial procurement planning or draft documents; roles and controls incomplete.
Documented competitive procurement and contract-management arrangements.
Established procurement/contract management system with performance monitoring.
dimensions.response: Develop procurement and contract-management guidance; strengthen performance monitoring.
dimensions.outputs: Procurement plan; bid documents; evaluation records; contract-management plan and KPIs.

dimensions.name: Market and stakeholder readiness
dimensions.evidence: Stakeholder mapping and consultation; market sounding; willingness/ability to pay; competition analysis; investor engagement.
levels: No documented stakeholder or market engagement.
Initial consultations or investor enquiries; evidence limited or unstructured.
Structured consultations and market sounding inform project design.
Regular market engagement and stakeholder feedback integrated into the pipeline.
dimensions.response: Institutionalise consultation and market sounding; test willingness/ability to pay and competition.
dimensions.outputs: Stakeholder plans; consultation reports; market sounding records; updated assumptions.

levels.d: No documented system or demonstrated capability; critical gaps remain.
levels.support: PPP awareness; legal/role orientation; focal-person designation; concept development.
levels.progress: Establish minimum mandates, responsibilities and basic records.

levels.d: Initial arrangements or isolated capability exist, but are incomplete or inconsistently applied.
levels.support: Applied workshops and coaching on screening, pre-feasibility, affordability, safeguards and procurement planning.
levels.progress: Convert initial arrangements into documented and consistently used procedures.

levels.d: Documented procedures, assigned personnel and evidence of implementation are available.
levels.support: Advanced feasibility/VfM and fiscal-risk support; procurement simulations; contract-management preparation.
levels.progress: Improve consistency, quality assurance, monitoring and coordination.

levels.d: Systems are routinely applied, monitored, improved and adequately resourced.
levels.support: Peer learning; specialist advice on complex projects; performance benchmarking.

gates.t: Statutory mandate, approvals pathway, required authorisations.
Ownership/tenure, site control, rights of way, encumbrances.
Affordability over the contract term, budget cover, contingent liabilities.
Screening, required assessments, community and rights impacts.

phases.a: Adopt PPP policy/guidance; clarify legal/approval pathways; establish coordination; design the evidence protocol.
phases.o: Policy and governance instruments; focal-person network; evidence protocol.

phases.a: Inventory project concepts; screen for service need, public value, strategic fit and affordability; prepare a limited pre-feasibility cohort.
phases.o: Prioritised inventory; transparent screening; pre-feasibility studies.

phases.a: Complete feasibility, demand, technical, economic and financial appraisal; affordability and fiscal-risk review; safeguards; market sounding.
phases.o: Appraisal package; fiscal-risk review; safeguards; procurement strategy.

phases.a: Prepare bid documents and contracts; conduct competitive procurement; award only with approvals; establish contract management.
phases.o: Procurement records; approved contract; contract-management plan; KPIs.

phases.a: Review performance and public value; refine policy and templates; expand the pipeline selectively.
phases.o: Performance reviews; updated toolkit; stronger systems; continuous improvement.
phases.gate: Evidence of public value and performance.
